title: Cracking NLP
blurb: Thirty-five NLP interview problems that start from raw strings and end at decoding, evaluation and tokenizer training. Each one pins down its conventions exactly, so you practise getting the details right rather than guessing them.
prereq: Comfortable Python, dictionaries and NumPy indexing, plus the basic idea of a softmax and of training a model by gradient descent.
next: Take these pieces into full Transformer language models and retrieval pipelines, where tokenizers, sampling and ranking meet real model weights.
